title: A staircase
prompt: Draw a staircase of three steps, each 20 up and 20 across.
hints: One step is forward 20, turn left, forward 20, turn right: up, then across. Three steps in all.
Four calls make one step; write them three times, or put them in a helper.

docs.name: move_forward(distance)
docs.what: Drives the turtle forward that many pixels, drawing a line. Takes one number; returns nothing.

docs.name: turn_left()
docs.what: Turns the turtle 90 degrees to the left. Give it a number to turn by a different angle.

docs.name: turn_right()
docs.what: Turns the turtle 90 degrees to the right. Give it a number to turn by a different angle.

solution:
func run():
	step()
	step()
	step()

func step():
	move_forward(20)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(20)
	turn_right()
